compound.name: (-)-menthol
compound.one_liner: Peppermint's cooling alcohol (30-55 % of the oil); the TRPM8 agonist.

identity.note: (-)-menthol (the natural peppermint enantiomer). MW read from 'Molecular Weight' heading.

occurrences.source_citation: EMA/HMPC. Assessment report on Mentha x piperita L., folium and aetheroleum, Rev. 1. EMA/HMPC/522409/2013 (15 Jan 2020). https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/herbal-report/assessment-report-mentha-x-piperita-l-folium-and-aetheroleum-revision-1_en.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: Duke: MENTHOL Leaf 570-22800 ppm and 156-20000 ppm. | Basis as recorded: % of essential oil (Ph. Eur. range)

pharmacology.mechanism: Menthol activates TRPM8, the same channel opened by cool temperatures, which is why it feels cold on skin and mucosa [38]. Peppermint oil also shows calcium-channel antagonism in animal studies [6].
pharmacology.functional_notes: The IBS evidence is for enteric-coated peppermint OIL capsules, not for isolated menthol [54].

evidence.claim: Menthol activates the cold-sensing ion channel TRPM8.
evidence.test_article_detail: menthol on cloned receptor / sensory neurons
evidence.outcome_summary: Receptor cloned and shown to respond to menthol and to cold.

processing_stability.volatility: steam-volatile: recovered in hydro/steam-distilled essential oil (see occurrence sources)
processing_stability.note: Solubility and heat-stability values not sourced in this pass.

safety_flags.detail: Menthol-containing peppermint oil preparations are contraindicated in children under 2 years.
safety_flags.source_citation: EU herbal monograph on Mentha x piperita L., aetheroleum, EMA/HMPC/522410/2013 Rev.1

compound.teaching_note: Menthol is the textbook case of a plant compound whose sensation has a single molecular explanation: the cold receptor TRPM8 [38]. The clinical story (IBS) is about the oil in a capsule, not the molecule alone [54].
gaps: Human PK of menthol not researched.
No RCT of isolated menthol read in this pass.
